To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the joint effect of waves and currents on the hydrodynamics and scour around the submarine pipelines are investigated.

the hydrodynamic forces and the local sediment scour around submarine pipelines under the combined effect of solitary waves with background currents are closely related to background current velocity, the diameter and the layout of the pipelines.
The hydrodynamic characteristics and the local scour mechanism around the pipeline under the joint effect of waves and currents are numerically studied.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the joint effect of the solitary waves and currents on the pipelines.
the hydrodynamic characteristics and the scour mechanism around submarine pipeline under the combined wave-current effect.
the hydrodynamic characteristics and the local scour mechanism around the submarine pipelines under the combined effect of the solitary waves and the background currents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hydrodynamic force and scouring depth of submarine pipelines are significantly affected by the combined effect of solitary waves, currents and pipelines.
the hydrodynamic force and local scour of submarine pipeline are closely related with the diameter and layout, and the joint effect of the wave and current.
the scour depth and the scour volume increase with the wave height and the diameter of the pipeline, and the scour hole is deeper for the suspended pipeline.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the scour hole is larger for the suspended pipelines, and the hydrodynamic characteristics and forces on the suspended pipeline are greater than those on the tandem pipeline.

the hydrodynamic force and the local scour hole are significantly affected by the background current, wave height, pipeline diameter and layout, and the tandem pipeline is more susceptible to the scour than the suspended one.

the pipeline diameter and layout have significant effects on the hydrodynamic characteristics and the local scour.
the hydrodynamic force and the scour hole depth are increased with the increase of the background currents.
